title: Foil cards and world-locked dithering
blurb: An interactive playing card drawn on one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas with Balatro-style Foil, Holographic, Polychrome and Negative shaders plus Return of the Obra Dinn 3D sphere-locked 1-bit dithering. Drag to tilt the card in 3D while clicking its counters and typing in its title.
question: Can one live interactive HTML playing card switch cleanly between Balatro-inspired metallic Foil, Holographic, Polychrome, and Negative optical coatings, plus Return of the Obra Dinn style 3D sphere-locked 1-bit Bayer and blue-noise dithering that stays anchored to the card in 3D space without screen swimming, while staying tilted and clickable?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context with texElementSubImage2D(), five optical shader editions, a toggle between screen-space and 3D view-sphere dithering, perspective updateElementGeometry() calibrated with geometryUnit(), a 2D drawElementImage() fallback and plain-HTML context-loss recovery.
